        About Dev Harbour · Mission & Ecosystem
      
        
      
        Empowering the Next Generation of Builders
        
      
        
        Dev Harbour is an open, modern learning and competition platform built to bridge the gap between academic theory and real-world engineering execution for students, self-taught developers, and vibe coders.
      
        
      
        
        
        
        
      
        
    
        

    
    
        
      
        🎯 Our Core Mission
        
      
        
        Traditional computer science education often leaves developers stranded between syntax tutorials and shipping production systems. Dev Harbour changes this paradigm by providing hands-on challenges, live sandboxed execution, national-scale hackathons, and event-specific certificate access in a single unified interface.
      
        
      
        
        Whether you are a college student writing your first backend API or an experienced hacker prototyping cutting-edge AI workflows, Dev Harbour gives you the arena to build in public, validate your skills, and earn a record of their participation and learning.
      
        
    
        

    
        
      
        
        
        💻 Practical Code Labs
        
        
        
          Learn by writing real code evaluated in secure serverless containers. Master data structures, distributed architectures, algorithms, and full-stack web development with instant feedback and XP rewards.
        
        
      
        
      
        
        
        🏆 National Hackathons
        
        
        
          We organize and host prestigious student hackathons including TATVA 2026 (National Online Hackathon on Unstop) and Orcathon 2K26, connecting high-potential talent with real prizes and industry mentorship.
        
        
      
        
      
        
        
        🛡️ Verified Credential Registry
        
        
        
          Event certificates have unique credential IDs checked against the platform registry. Access depends on event eligibility and verified account ownership.
        
        
      
        
      
        
        
        ⚡ High-Performance Architecture
        
        
        
          The website uses cloud hosting and a PostgreSQL database. Availability and response times depend on the network and service providers.
        
        
      
        
    
        

    
        
      
        👩‍💻 Founded with Passion
        
      
        
        Dev Harbour was founded by Rujula Sharma with a clear vision: to create an equitable, transparent, and vibrant launchpad for developers across India and worldwide. We believe talent is distributed equally, and opportunity should be as well.
      
        
      
        
        Connect with the founder directly on LinkedIn or join the community discussion on our official WhatsApp network.

        Legal & Platform Governance
      
        
      
        Terms and Conditions of Use
        
      
        
        Last updated: November 3, 2026 · Please review these terms carefully before accessing or using the Dev Harbour platform, hackathons, and credential registry.
      
        
      
        
        
        
      
        
    
        

    
        
      
        1. Acceptance of Terms
        
      
        
        By accessing or using the Dev Harbour website (devharbour.in), participating in associated hackathons (including TATVA and Orcathon), claiming verified certificates, or utilizing our interactive learning code sandboxes, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the platform.
      
        
    
        

    
        
      
        2. User Accounts & Email Verification
        
      
        
        To access personalized features, earn XP, publish projects, and claim participation credentials, users may create an account using email/password authentication or authorized Google Identity Services (OAuth/FedCM).
      
        
      
          
        
        • Email Verification: Email registrations require 6-digit cryptographic OTP verification to confirm email ownership before granting full account access.
          • 
        
        • Credential Security: You are responsible for safeguarding your login credentials and maintaining the confidentiality of your account.
          • 
        
        • Prohibited Sharing: Impersonation, automated bulk registrations, or selling Dev Harbour accounts is strictly forbidden.
          • 
      
        
    
        

    
        
      
        3. Code Sandbox & Platform Safety Rules
        
      
        
        Dev Harbour provides in-browser and server-side code execution sandboxes for learning and challenge evaluation. Users agree not to:
      
        
      
          
        
        • Attempt VM escapes, privilege escalation, or unauthorized probing of host server processes.
          • 
        
        • Execute denial-of-service (DoS) attacks, crypto-mining software, automated scraping bots, or network port scans.
          • 
        
        • Bypass security controls, rate limiting, or backend authentication middlewares.
          • 
      
        
    
        

    
        
      
        4. Competitions, Hackathons & Prizes
        
      
        
        Dev Harbour organizes, co-organizes, and lists developer competitions, including the TATVA 2026 National Hackathon.
      
        
      
          
        
        • Originality: All code and project submissions must be original work created during the designated competition period unless stated otherwise in official event guidelines.
          • 
        
        • Fair Play: Plagiarism, dishonest team registrations, or submitting pre-existing closed source projects will result in immediate disqualification.
          • 
        
        • Prize Distribution: Hackathon prize pools, AI cloud credits, and grant distribution are fulfilled through official partner channels (e.g. Unstop and sponsoring platforms) according to published competition schedules.
          • 
      
        
    
        

    
        
      
        5. Verified Credential Registry & Certificate Policy
        
      
        
        Official participation certificates and completion credentials issued by Dev Harbour are backed by our Supabase PostgreSQL authoritative ledger.
      
        
      
          
        
        • Ownership: Authenticated participants can directly view, verify, and download their personalized SVG/PNG credentials with zero extra passcodes.
          • 
        
        • Authenticity: Public verification allows employers and institutions to verify credential validity via Credential ID without exposing private participant emails.
          • 
        
        • Revocation: Dev Harbour reserves the right to revoke any certificate obtained through misrepresentation, impersonation, or academic dishonesty.
          • 
      
        
    
        

    
        
      
        6. Intellectual Property
        
      
        
        You retain 100% ownership of any original code, project repositories, and technical solutions you author and submit on Dev Harbour. The Dev Harbour platform design, trademarks, logos, certificate layouts, and original educational curriculum remain the intellectual property of Dev Harbour and Rujula Sharma.
      
        
    
        

    
        
      
        7. Disclaimers & Governing Law
        
      
        
        Dev Harbour services are provided on an "as-is" and "as-available" basis without warranties of any kind. These terms are governed by and construed under the laws of India. For legal notices, contact legal@devharbour.in.
